content.bridge_context: Set in ancient Japan, this story teaches the virtue of 'filial piety' (respect for parents) and the idea that nature rewards the pure of heart.

units.title: Respect for Elders
units.explanation: Taro's primary motivation is to make his old parents happy and comfortable.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss how you can help your parents at home. / चर्चा करें कि आप घर पर अपने माता-पिता की मदद कैसे कर सकते हैं।

units.title: Folktale Elements
units.explanation: Magic waterfalls and unexpected rewards are common elements in folktales used to convey moral lessons.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the magical part of the story. / कहानी के जादुई हिस्से की पहचान करें।
